newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P assigns AssiDoman commercial paper K-1/A-1.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AssiDoman commercial paper K-1/A-1.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard & Poor's (S&P) on Tuesday assigned a K-1/A-1 shortterm rating to Swedish forestry group AssiDoman's three billion crown Swedish commercial paper programme.
It also affirmed AssiDoman's A longterm credit rating and A-1 shortterm rating, outlook stable.
The agency said it expected to assign an A-1 shortterm rating to AssiDoman's $750 million euro commercial paper programme.
S&P said in a statement that AssiDoman was one of the most well-integrated forest products companies in Europe.

"With production highly concentrated to Sweden, AssiDoman is exposed to the cost development in Sweden, and key challenges will be to continue rationalisation and maintain a competitive cost position and to continue to develop products where its virgin fibres have competitive advantage," the agency said.
S&P said AssiDoman had been quick to explore opportunities in central and eastern Europe where its potential was substantial.

"While it is anticipated that AssiDoman will continue to grow through acquisitions and that leverage could increase as a result, the group is, nevertheless, expected to maintain a sound financial profile," S&P said.
